title: Rokeby Protein Smoothie 425ml $3 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Rokeby Protein Smoothie 425ml $3 @ Woolworths

[TEER3X] Dutch chocolate protein snack (different product to these smoothies) reminded me of chocolate yogo when I was a kid. It is delicious.
I'll give these a go.
[Ipodisclassic] Do you any extra ingredients/xantham gum or just pour into the creami pint and freeze?
[BenTheBargainer2013] The sweetener in the rokeby seems to deactivate when frozen, i use monkfruit sweetener
However I've stopped drinking these because i reckon they are too calorie dense for the amount of protein
[Ipodisclassic] I kinda stopped using my creami for this reason. Yes, you can make a giant tub of "healthy" ice cream. But none of them hit the same as the real thing I've found :/
[rbimdxe] They're not a "protein shake" the same way a scoop of WPI in a shaker of water is.
They're a whole milk product, so they've got higher fat and sugar content that your supplement style protein shakes.
They typically taste a lot better - and that's because of the fats and sugars.
It's better than an up n go energise, for example, but if youre only looking to increase protein specifically, then a supplement powder/RTD is the way to go.
[donman92] @rbimdxe: I love using 4 scoops of choc whey protein and water ..maybe a tablespoon of milk powder if I'm feeling special. Amazing macros and costs me 20-30c per pint lol
[Wolfenstein98k] @donman92: What protein powder are you buying that costs you that little per serve?
[donman92] @Wolfenstein98k: Back in late 2023 there was a sale for $10kg for clearance sale whey protein so I bought 25kg. Shared a while bunch with my brother in law and I now I'm finally using up the rest especially thanks to the ninja creami. Its best before is Feb 2022 but it's been kept in a dark corner so it's fine.
[Wolfenstein98k] Yeah, but unflavoured, not single serve and portable, and not coffee.
[donman92] Bold of you thinking I don't polish off those 2L ones in one sitting as my breaky 🤣🤷
[ScribbleSass] $2.70 not very long ago, but still a good price.
[eathb] Anyone know if it has longish expiry date? Will stock up for Path of Exole 3.30
[Wolfenstein98k] Months long. But please don't clean them out of stock!
[Max0309] Go to your wollies and check . They won’t pull out some short dated stock only for this special . Mostly u will buy what’s already on shelves just on different price
[Lets Make Sandwiches] These are great when working out in morning. Good carb source with a heap of protein.
[Wolfenstein98k] And caffeine! One of the larger serves you'll find in a bottled product.
[Lets Make Sandwiches] I'm a massive fan of the espresso flavour. Normally I like cookies and cream flavours, but I would personally say it's their worst one.
[stuckster] Only 7% protein. Wow. It's a bit of a stretch calling this a protein shake! Lol.
If all you want is a chocolate flavoured milk drink then go for it. But this is definitely not a great choice for a lean source of protein. By comparison, most actual protein powders contain about 65-80% protein.
[RecklessMonkeys] It's got almost as much sugar in it. I'd treat it more as a protein snack.
[Wolfenstein98k] Incorrect.
425mL (one bottle) of this has:
287 calories
30g protein
8.5g added sugar
Whereas 425mL of chocolate milk would have:
382 calories (+33%)
15g protein (-50%)
45g added sugar (+430%!!!!)
Using total carbs, including galactose etc, it's still +74%.
Just because you can say things doesn't mean you should. In fact, you probably shouldn't, especially when they're false.
[RecklessMonkeys] I wasn't comparing it to flavoured milk, although I can see how i might have given that impression.
I was comparing it's own sugar vs protein.
It has 25.1 grams of sugar and 30 grams of protein. ie 84% as much sugar as protein. ie "almost as much"
The second most prevalent ingredient is sugar cane.
Maybe tone down the condescending tone a bit.
[Wolfenstein98k] Wtf are you talking about?
This product is a RTD coffee drink with protein (not from powder, if you care about that).
287 calories, 30g protein. Nearly as protein-dense as a scotch fillet.
Yes, protein powder in water is higher density of protein, but this is single-serve, portable, equivalent in caffeine to a triple shot coffee, and delicious in taste and texture.
If you have a scoop of Bulk Nutrients WPC in milk, to get close to the texture, you'll end up having more calories as this anyway.
Who companies percent of a viscous liquid to percent of a powder?
[MustResistPurchase] Perhaps Little Miss Muffet only eats her curds and whey.
[drazenm] They're now SH like all other brands in this department.
They're trying to take more space on the store shelves by pumping out as much as possible new flavors.
They've reformulated their drinks and most are becoming with artificial sweeteners.
Espresso was my favorite until they've reformulated it, reduced coffee from 1.7% to 1.1% and added salt so it would mimic the bitter coffee flavor…instead of feeling the actual coffee flavor 🤣
Another interesting thing is I've noticed the change long before they've officially changed ingredients printing on the bottle. Must have been reported by multiple users and forced to come clean with actual, current ingredients list.
Waiting to see how much more are they gonna slump down, keep on adding more fillers and increase the price more, then I'll give them a dump!
Tried their pudings, they taste very watery, more like jelly, they're almost see through how little actually dairy they contain. Flavour is weak, chocolate and caramel are OKish, coffee was terrible, just tasteless.
[jt14] feels like they have ultra pro max lactose in them! any lactose free options please if you know?
